title: Scheme of characteristic p
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number. A scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] is *of characteristic $p$* (also: *has characteristic $p$*, *is in characteristic $p$*) if $p$ is zero in its structure sheaf [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]: for every open subset $U\subseteq X$, the section $p\cdot1_{\mathcal O_X(U)}$ is zero in the ring $\mathcal O_X(U)$. The empty scheme satisfies this condition for every $p$.

source.place: Varieties, Section 33.36 'Frobenii' (tag 0CC6), first paragraph, before Definition 33.36.1
